sections.p: TumTumPa is a tool for musicians: chord sheets, setlists, a stage player, rehearsal tools and a community of musicians and bands.

Sign-up data (username, name, e-mail, city and instruments); content you create (songs, setlists, profile, bands, posts, comments, hiring requests); usage data (last login, login and session counts, songs played); and subscription data (Stripe status and identifiers — we never store card data).
To provide the service, keep your account safe, bill subscriptions, alert you about bands in your city and instrument, moderate the community and improve the product.

Your profile and bands start private. Only what you publish (public profile, posts, gigs) is visible to others. Your contact (e-mail, phone or WhatsApp) is only shown to logged-in users. You can switch your profile back to private at any time.

With the providers that make the service work: Vercel (hosting and file storage), Neon (database), Stripe (payments) and, when you use the related features, YouTube (embedded videos) and OpenAI (chord sheet suggestions). We do not sell your data.

You can access and correct your data in Settings and My profile, and delete your account on the Profile page (this erases your profile, posts, comments, bands and invitations; songs and setlists in the shared library remain without an author). For other requests provided by data-protection law (full access, portability, processing information), contact support.

Do not post spam, scams, insults, harassment, illegal content or content that infringes copyright or image rights, and do not impersonate anyone. Reported content may be hidden and accounts may be suspended. Hiring is arranged directly between the parties: TumTumPa does not handle payments or contracts and is not responsible for agreements made in the community — never pay strangers in advance.
The community is intended for people over 18, or minors with the permission and supervision of their guardians.
We use encrypted connections, hashed passwords and abuse limits. We keep data while the account exists; when you delete it, personal data is removed, except what the law requires us to keep.
